source: CES cumulative 2006-2025, 2018 and 2022 midterms (pre- and post-election waves)

variables.pi: Senate voters (voted_sen a candidate, post wave) who were unsure before (intent_sen 'Not Sure' or 'No One') or whose vote differs from intent_sen; weight_post
variables.mu: respondents matched to an active registration (vv_regstatus): intent_turnout_self 'Probably', 'Undecided' or missing, or firm intenders without a validated vote (vv_turnout_gvm), or 'No' with one; weight
